prompt_text: Search for objects. Once an object has been detected, approach it, and, once it has been reached, pick it up and search for a suitable drop-off zone which could be the red zone, the blue zone, or both. Once a suitable zone has been detected, approach it. Once it has been reached, drop the object. This in turn automatically triggers a broadcast message that indicates the zone to which the object was delivered. Following delivery, resume with search to repeat the process indefinitely. At all times, keep track of the difference in the number of objects delivered to the red and blue zones. Choose which zones to deliver to such that the number of objects delivered to either differs always by -1 (i.e., the blue zone received one delivery more than the red zone), 0 (i.e., both zones received an equal amount of deliveries), or 1 (i.e., the red zone received one delivery more than the blue zone).
